sections.text: Introduction

Type (DZ2) two
distance protection relay is used either for basic or backup protection of
high tension transmission lines on lines with high short circuit currents to
earth. The relay provides for selective isolation of line to line short circuits
in systems of any lay out . (DZ2 ) protective relay can be Transformed into
a threestep distance relay by supplementing it with an additional device type
(KPC 1) comprising three starting directional impedance units. The proactive
relay is designed to operate together with outofstep Blocking device type
(kp6-126) which also services as the starting element.

The
first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Mostafa Abd El-Gawad, tested at 27/4/02, 
Samalout 500, ME.

items:

 are shorted and VT secondary circuits are open.

Prior to Starting Testing
 Procedure (s) Ensure the Following Steps

items: This procedure is used to perform off load relay testing.

Check that the panel Nameplate agrees with the EEC designation of the line
 that has been taken out of service for maintenance.
Check there is no AC current from CT by using clip-on ammeter.
Check there is no AC voltage from VT by using voltmeter.

Check all external connections to the relay are in good condition and
 check that the terminal
 block wires are tight.
